shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls && ls src 2>/dev/null; grep -rl -i "middleware" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20

cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/middleware.md | head -40; echo ------; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; ls app __agent_eval__; cat tsconfig.json

cd /workspace; f=node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; grep -n -E "^#|runtime|matcher|export default|export function|crypto|setting-headers" $f | head -60; ls app __agent_eval__; cat tsconfig.json

(npx next dev -p 3456 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; curl -sI http://localhost:3456/ | grep -i x-request-id; curl -sI http://localhost:3456/foo | grep -i x-request-id; sleep 1; grep -v "^$" /tmp/dev.log | tail -15; pkill -f "next dev"
cd /workspace; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts; git status --short
